refresh_conclusion: S38 remains the newest promoted source and stays historical direct-complementary only, with zero H1-H5 numeric effect. The 18:34 EEST official/institutional follow-up found no defensible S39: the newest Centru digitalisation contracts, Prahova training-course offer and Dolj transition project are implementation/supply context, not need evidence. The Covasna 2026 report remains pending actual content readback.
next_refresh_rule: Promote a new source only when its actual content can be read and it provides materially stronger target-population evidence with enough provenance and method detail to classify its limits. A listing, project objective, funding offer, technology deployment or training activity is insufficient.
